policy.new_capability_rule: Every new capability must map to an existing claim or introduce a new falsifiable claim before it is treated as research-relevant.
policy.review_policy: Reviewers must check that every claim remains falsifiable, evidence status is bounded by observed evidence, proof references resolve, and schema compatibility is preserved.

claim:paphos-firmware-cycle.falsifier: After deploy, a staged kernel or pending capsule is not booted within a day, or the journal shows 'Outside of configured reboot window, skipping.' at a 05:00 run.
claim:paphos-firmware-cycle.statement: paphos applies LVFS firmware at 04:30 and reboots for a pending capsule at 06:00 inside its window, and its upgrade reboots land inside 05:00-06:30.

claim:paphos-unattended-unlock.falsifier: After enrollment and an upgrade reboot, paphos waits for the passphrase on initrd SSH port 2222.
claim:paphos-unattended-unlock.statement: After Tang enrollment, paphos reboots in its 05:00-06:30 window and unlocks its LUKS root without a passphrase.

claim:replace-template-claim:question:pr.decision_impact: Determines the first repository-specific research claim and its required proof.

checkpoints.summary: Daily verified Mother checkpoint through Swamp, with a paphos heartbeat check. Two live runs verified.

boundaries: No firmware or DSM/SRM installer actions. Existing backup jobs, SSH restrictions and credentials stay unchanged.
intent:run_mother_checkpoint_swamp.raw_intent: Back up the limited Mother recovery set to loving-kypris and run it through Swamp, autonomously, with verified restores.
intent:run_mother_checkpoint_swamp.refined_intent: Run the limited Mother recovery checkpoint each day through a Swamp workflow on loving-kypris. Each run prepares fresh source data, makes a new Zerobyte snapshot, restores it independently with Restic, and deletes temporary copies only after that proof. paphos alerts through its existing Telegram health check when no verified checkpoint arrives within 36 hours.

stop_conditions: An API warning, an old success, a stale receipt, a changed resource binding or a failed independent restore must not count as a verified checkpoint.

observations: On 2026-11-01, two live runs verified. The direct run made snapshot 88b1a016. The Swamp service run 99fa57f6 succeeded and made snapshot 02562414. Each passed restic check --read-data and restored a byte-identical archive with 353,662 entries, 14 PostgreSQL exports and 3 intact SQLite databases.
The read-only SRM API, behind the pinned certificate, reported three nodes on SRM 1.3.2-9366 Update 3. Mesh status was good, no upgrade was pending, and no patch was available.
nix eval for nixosConfigurations.paphos passes. 23 tests, ty, shellcheck, alejandra and the decapod override check pass.
Three historical done-but-unverified records were reset with decapod qa verify prune, on the user decision. The deadlock is filed upstream as DecapodLabs/decapod#1473.
validation_findings: loving-kypris was unreachable at 06:00 UTC on 2026-11-02, so the first scheduled 00:30 run is unverified until the host is back.
